Based on parent reviews and ratings, here are some of the top-rated language immersion preschools in and around Westwood, Los Angeles:

**1. WorldSpeak Preschool** (1639 Westwood Blvd)
This is arguably the most well-known multilingual immersion option right in Westwood. WorldSpeak is a multilingual preschool with French, Russian, Mandarin, Spanish, and Ukrainian immersion programs, featuring native-speaking teachers that help young students become bilingual before entering elementary school, and has been open for over two decades, nurturing over 2,500 young minds. Parents note "The teachers and director at WorldSpeak are wonderful... Our son is in the Spanish immersion program."

**2. Intiwasi Spanish Immersion School**
Highly rated with an A+ Niche grade. A parent review shares: "We absolutely love Intiwasi Spanish Immersion School! The program is truly exceptional—my daughter surprises me every day with how much she has learned and continues to learn... The teachers are incredibly kind, caring, and dedicated... The food is another highlight—always fresh, nutritious, and thoughtfully prepared."

**3. Saint Sebastian School (West LA)** — Spanish Immersion Program
This Catholic preschool offers dedicated Spanish immersion for young children. It's a private, Catholic coed preschool in West Los Angeles for 2 and 3 year olds with Spanish language immersion, offering full Spanish Immersion classrooms where teachers speak to children completely in Spanish to create an "immersion" experience. Parents praise it: "Saint Sebastian School is a wonderful school for all of students. First, all of teachers are nice, passionate and professional. They always give kids a warm hug when they need it. Second, the team of the school is the best. A younger and responsible principal, the helping front desk, the best teacher and other nice staff."

**4. Hollywood Schoolhouse**
While its main immersion comparison is public dual-language programs, it draws strong reviews from parents transitioning from immersion settings. One parent noted: "Our first-grade child transferred to Hollywood Schoolhouse mid-year after we withdrew her from a dual-language immersion public school, and the difference has been remarkable."

**5. Smaller/boutique immersion options nearby**
